# CalcBlueprint

> Free construction calculators for contractors, estimators, and DIY. Instant material estimates for concrete, roofing, flooring, paint, and more. No signup, no account, no ads before results.

CalcBlueprint is an independent tool site built by Emiliano. Every calculator uses published formulas from ACI 318, NRCA, IRC, TCNA, ASTM, and manufacturer specifications — not proprietary algorithms. Results are estimates for planning; verify with a licensed professional before ordering materials.

## Most Used Calculators

- [Concrete Slab Cost Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-slab-cost-calculator/): Calculate concrete slab cost instantly. Enter length, width, and thickness to get cubic yards, bags, and total cost including labor.
- [Concrete Mix Ratio Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-mix-calculator/): Calculate cement, sand, and aggregate ratios for any concrete mix by PSI target. Enter volume for exact cement bags, sand tons, and gravel needed.
- [Deck Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/deck-calculator/): Calculate deck boards, joists, and posts needed for your deck project. Enter dimensions to get a complete material list.
- [Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/tile-calculator/): Calculate tiles, boxes, thinset, and grout for any floor or wall. Enter room dimensions, tile size, and waste % for exact material quantities.
- [Paint Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/paint-calculator/): Calculate exact paint gallons for walls, ceilings, and trim. Enter room size, coats, and window openings for a precise coverage and cost estimate.
- [Roof Area Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-area-calculator/): Calculate true roof surface area from footprint and pitch. Enter building length, width, and pitch ratio for exact area with the 5% waste allowance.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gravel-calculator/): Calculate how much gravel you need for driveways, walkways, and landscaping. Enter area and depth for instant tons and cubic yards.
- [Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/fence-calculator/): Calculate fence posts, rails, pickets, and concrete needed for any fence length. Enter linear feet, height, and picket spacing for a complete material list.

## Concrete & Masonry

- [Concrete Footing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-footing-calculator/): Calculate concrete for footings and foundations. Enter footing width, depth, and total length for exact cubic yards with 10% waste included.
- [Concrete Steps Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-steps-calculator/): Calculate concrete volume and bag count for outdoor steps and stairways. Enter rise, run, and width for instant estimates.
- [Concrete Stairs Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-stairs-calculator/): Calculate concrete for exterior stairs and steps. Enter total rise, tread depth, and stair width for exact cubic yards, bags, and rebar needed.
- [Concrete Column Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-column-calculator/): Calculate concrete for round, square, or rectangular columns. Enter column diameter, height, and quantity for exact cubic yards and bag count.
- [Concrete Block Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/concrete-block-calculator/): Calculate concrete blocks and mortar needed for any wall or foundation. Enter wall length, height, and block size for exact material quantities.
- [Rebar Spacing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/rebar-spacing-calculator/): Calculate rebar spacing, grid layout, and total linear feet for concrete slabs and footings. Free tool for contractors and DIY.
- [How Many Bags of Concrete? Slab Size Chart](https://calcblueprint.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete/): How many bags of concrete for a 10x10 slab, 4x4 post, or driveway? Reference table shows 60lb and 80lb bag counts by slab size and thickness.

## Roofing & Gutters

- [Roof Pitch Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-pitch-calculator/): Calculate bricks, mortar bags, and sand for any wall or patio. Enter wall dimensions, brick size, and joint width for exact material quantities.
- [Roof Truss Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/roof-truss-calculator/): Calculate roof trusses for any house. Enter building width, roof pitch, and truss spacing for exact truss count, span, and uplift requirements.
- [Shingle Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/shingle-calculator/): Calculate how many bundles of shingles you need for your roof. Enter roof area and pitch to get instant bundles, squares, and waste factor.
- [Ridge Vent Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/ridge-vent-calculator/): Calculate ridge vent for any attic. Enter attic floor area, roof pitch, and vent type for exact ridge vent linear feet and net free vent area needed.
- [Gutter Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gutter-calculator/): Calculate gutters, downspouts, and hangers for any home. Enter roof area, roof pitch, and downspout count for exact linear feet and fittings.

## Stairs & Framing

- [Stair Stringer Calculator — Rise, Run & Cut Length](https://calcblueprint.com/stair-stringer-calculator/): Calculate stair stringer length, angle, and notch layout. Enter total rise, tread depth, and stair width for exact cuts, board size, and stringer count.
- [Board Foot Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/board-foot-calculator/): Calculate board feet for lumber purchases. Enter thickness, width, length, and quantity to get total board feet and cost.

## Flooring & Tile

- [Grout Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/grout-calculator/): Calculate grout for any tile installation. Enter tile size, joint width, and total area for exact grout pounds, kilograms, and bag count needed.
- [Thinset Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/thinset-calculator/): Calculate thinset mortar for any tile job. Enter tile area, trowel size, and tile type for exact 50-lb bag quantities and per-bag coverage rate.
- [Backsplash Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/backsplash-calculator/): Calculate backsplash tile for any kitchen. Enter counter length, backsplash height, and outlets for exact tile count, thinset, and grout needed.
- [Shower Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/shower-tile-calculator/): Calculate shower wall and floor tile, thinset, and grout. Enter shower dimensions, tile size, and waste % for exact material quantities needed.
- [Bathroom Floor Tile Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/bathroom-floor-tile-calculator/): Calculate bathroom floor tile count, thinset, and grout. Enter floor dimensions, tile size, and waste % for a complete bathroom tile material list.
- [Kitchen Floor Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/kitchen-floor-calculator/): Calculate tile, laminate, or vinyl for any kitchen floor. Enter kitchen dimensions, floor material, and waste % for exact material and cost.

## Walls, Ceilings & Finishes

- [Drywall Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-calculator/): Calculate drywall sheets, joint compound, and screws for any room. Enter room dimensions and ceiling height for a complete material and cost estimate.
- [Drywall Mud Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-mud-calculator/): Calculate joint compound for any drywall job. Enter sheet count, joint length, and finish level for exact mud, tape, and bucket quantities needed.
- [Drywall Screws Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/drywall-screws-calculator/): Calculate drywall screw quantity for any job. Enter drywall sheet count, stud spacing, and stud length for exact screw count and bulk box quantity.
- [Drywall Corner Bead Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/corner-bead-calculator/): Calculate corner bead for drywall installations. Enter wall height, outside corner count, and bead type for exact linear feet and box quantity.
- [Wall Area Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wall-area-calculator/): Calculate wall area for paint, wallpaper, or siding. Enter room dimensions and subtract doors and windows for exact net wall square footage.

## Siding & Exterior

- [Vinyl Siding Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/vinyl-siding-calculator/): Calculate vinyl siding squares, trim, and accessories for any home. Enter wall area, siding dimensions, and waste % for exact materials needed.
- [Hardie Plank Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/hardie-plank-calculator/): Calculate Hardie plank siding for any exterior wall. Enter wall area, board dimensions, and overlap for exact siding boards and waste allowance.

## Fencing & Gates

- [Chain Link Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/chain-link-fence-calculator/): Calculate chain link fence materials for any yard. Enter linear feet, height, and post spacing for exact rolls, posts, rails, and tension wire.
- [Privacy Fence Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/privacy-fence-calculator/): Calculate privacy fence materials for any yard. Enter linear feet, height, and picket spacing for exact lumber, posts, rails, and concrete needed.
- [Fence Gate Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/gate-calculator/): Calculate gate materials for any fence project. Enter gate width, height, and post size for exact lumber, hardware, and concrete quantities needed.

## Paving & Landscaping

- [Mulch Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/mulch-calculator/): Calculate mulch volume for any landscape bed or garden. Enter area dimensions and desired depth for exact cubic yards, cubic feet, and bag counts needed.
- [Sod Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/sod-calculator/): Calculate sod rolls or pallets for any lawn. Enter lawn dimensions and sod roll size for exact square footage, rolls, and pallet quantities needed.
- [Compost Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/compost-calculator/): Calculate compost volume for lawns, gardens, and raised beds. Enter area dimensions and depth for exact cubic yards, cubic feet, or bag counts.
- [Fertilizer Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/fertilizer-calculator/): Calculate fertilizer quantity for any lawn or garden. Enter square footage, N-P-K ratio, and target rate for exact pounds and bag count needed.
- [Grass Seed Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/grass-seed-calculator/): Calculate grass seed quantity for any lawn. Enter square footage, grass type, and seeding rate for exact pounds of seed and overseed quantity needed.
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/topsoil-calculator/): Calculate topsoil for lawns, gardens, and raised beds. Enter area dimensions and depth for exact cubic yards, cubic feet, or bag counts needed.
- [Artificial Turf Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/artificial-turf-calculator/): Calculate artificial turf rolls and square footage for any lawn or patio. Enter area dimensions and turf roll width for exact material and seam quantities.
- [Paver Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/paver-calculator/): Calculate pavers, sand, and gravel for driveways and patios. Enter area dimensions and paver size for exact paver count, base, and joint sand.

## HVAC

- [AC Unit Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/ac-unit-size-calculator/): Calculate AC unit size in tons for any home. Enter square footage, ceiling height, and climate zone for precise cooling capacity and BTU sizing.
- [BTU Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/btu-calculator/): Calculate BTU cooling and heating needs for any room. Enter room size, ceiling height, window count, and occupants for precise AC and furnace sizing.
- [Furnace Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/furnace-size-calculator/): Calculate furnace size in BTUs for any home. Enter square footage, climate zone, and insulation level for precise heating capacity recommendations.
- [Duct Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/duct-size-calculator/): Calculate HVAC duct size for any room. Enter CFM airflow, duct type, and run length for exact round or rectangular duct dimensions and velocities.

## Electrical

- [Electrical Load Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/electrical-load-calculator/): Calculate electrical load for any home or service panel. Enter appliances, square footage, and voltage for exact amperage and panel size needed.
- [Wire Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wire-size-calculator/): Calculate wire gauge for any circuit. Enter amp load, wire run length, and voltage drop limit for exact AWG wire size and conduit recommendation.
- [Breaker Size Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/breaker-size-calculator/): Calculate breaker size and wire gauge for any circuit. Enter amp load, voltage, and wire run for safe breaker, wire, and conduit recommendations.
- [Outlet Spacing Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/outlet-spacing-calculator/): Calculate outlet spacing and total count for any room. Enter wall length, ceiling height, and local code spacing for exact outlet placement and count.

## Other Calculators

- [Asphalt Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/asphalt-calculator/): Calculate tons of asphalt needed for driveways and parking lots. Enter area and thickness for accurate material estimates.
- [Brick Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/brick-calculator/): Calculate bricks, mortar bags, and sand for any wall, patio, or chimney. Enter wall dimensions, brick size, and joint width for exact material quantities.
- [Carpet Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/carpet-calculator/): Calculate carpet square yards and padding for any room. Enter dimensions and roll width for exact yardage, seams, and total material needed.
- [Hardwood Flooring Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/hardwood-flooring-calculator/): Calculate hardwood planks and cartons for any room. Enter room dimensions, plank size, and waste % for exact flooring quantities and board feet.
- [Insulation Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/insulation-calculator/): Calculate insulation for walls, ceilings, and attics. Enter square footage, R-value target, and insulation type for exact batts, rolls, or blown-in bags.
- [Laminate Flooring Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/laminate-flooring-calculator/): Calculate laminate flooring planks and cartons for any room. Enter room dimensions, plank size, and waste % for exact box count, plank count, and cost.
- [Mortar Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/mortar-calculator/): Calculate mortar, sand, and cement for brick or block walls. Enter wall area, unit size, and joint width for exact mortar bags and sand volume.
- [Retaining Wall Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/retaining-wall-calculator/): Calculate retaining wall blocks, capstones, and gravel. Enter wall length, height, and block type for exact blocks, base, and drainage stone needed.
- [Wallpaper Calculator](https://calcblueprint.com/wallpaper-calculator/): Calculate wallpaper rolls for any room. Enter wall dimensions, roll size, and pattern repeat for exact roll count, match allowance, and waste.

## Notes

- All calculators are free and require no signup or account.
- Formula sources: ACI 318 (concrete), NRCA (roofing), IRC and ICC (framing and stairs), TCNA (tile), ASTM (materials), AWC NDS (lumber).
- Results are planning estimates. Verify with a licensed professional before ordering materials or beginning structural work.
- Contact: hello@calcblueprint.com
